articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Extended Context and Multimodal Reasoning
articles.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5 Turbo, featuring a 2-million token context window and enhanced multimodal reasoning capabilities across text, images, audio, and video. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-document analysis and real-time audio understanding. Enterprise rollout begins this week with consumer access expected within the month.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaCode 3 Solves Competitive Programming at Expert Human Level
articles.summary: DeepMind released a paper showing AlphaCode 3 achieving gold-medal performance on the International Olympiad in Informatics benchmark, surpassing all previous AI systems. The model uses a novel agentic self-debugging loop that iteratively refines solutions through test execution. Researchers say the architecture could generalize to broader scientific problem-solving domains.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI 2.0 Framework for Safer Agent Deployment
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new safety framework called Constitutional AI 2.0, designed specifically for autonomous agents operating in multi-step environments. The system introduces real-time value alignment checks that pause agent actions when potential harms exceed configurable thresholds. The framework is now open-sourced and available for integration with third-party agentic platforms.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Adds Advanced RAG Pipeline Builder for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
articles.summary: Microsoft unveiled a drag-and-drop RAG pipeline builder within Copilot Studio, allowing enterprises to connect proprietary data sources including SharePoint, Salesforce, and SAP without writing code. The tool includes automatic chunking optimization and hybrid search combining dense and sparse retrieval methods. Early adopters report a 40% improvement in answer accuracy over previous retrieval configurations.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Fine-Tuning Toolkit Under Open License
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced a comprehensive fine-tuning toolkit for its Llama 4 Scout model, enabling developers to customize the 17-billion parameter model on consumer-grade GPUs. The toolkit includes quantization utilities, LoRA adapters, and pre-built instruction templates for common enterprise use cases. The release has already sparked thousands of community fine-tuned variants on Hugging Face within 48 hours.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Formal Warnings to Three Tech Giants
articles.summary: The newly established European AI Office issued formal compliance warnings to three unnamed major technology companies for deploying general-purpose AI systems without required transparency documentation. The warnings mark the first enforcement actions under the EU AI Act's general-purpose AI provisions, which came into full effect in February 2026. Companies have 60 days to submit remediation plans or face fines of up to 3% of global revenue.

articles.title: Runway Gen-4 Video Model Generates Coherent 10-Minute Cinematic Sequences
articles.summary: Runway AI demonstrated Gen-4, a video generation model capable of producing temporally consistent cinematic sequences up to 10 minutes long from text and image prompts. The model maintains character consistency, lighting continuity, and narrative coherence across extended clips, a major leap over previous 30-second limitations. Several independent film studios have already announced pilot projects using the technology for pre-visualization.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns Agentic AI Systems Creating New Cybersecurity Attack Surface
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute identifies agentic AI systems with tool-use capabilities as an emerging cybersecurity risk, cataloguing over 200 documented prompt injection attacks against deployed agents in 2025. Researchers warn that as agents gain access to email, calendars, and financial systems, adversarial manipulation could cause significant real-world harm. The report calls for mandatory sandboxing standards and third-party audits before enterprise agent deployments.
